title: E-QTM-0088: the measurement amplifier quantified: the fitted Lyapunov exponent of the arrow-driven committed rule is...
purpose: Experiment E-QTM-0088 in the quantum arena: the measurement amplifier quantified: the fitted Lyapunov exponent of the arrow-driven committed rule is essentially zero at dead peace (the reversible rule is non-chaotic) and clearly positive for arrow above zero (about 0.03 to 0.085 per beat, peaking near arrow 0.05), so the arrow supplies a measured positive exponential amplification rate the reversible rule lacks.
